name: Dead Men Tell No Tales
tagline: Buried treasure, a mutinous crew, and a captain face-down in the rum.
description: In a lawless port, the most feared captain on the seas is found dead the night before dividing the treasure. Quartermasters, stowaways, a governor's daughter and a parrot who saw everything.
artStyle: Old nautical map illustration, weathered parchment, lantern-lit tavern

cocktails.name: Dead Man's Grog
cocktails.recipe: Dark rum, lime, brown sugar and hot water.
cocktails.mocktail: Hot apple juice with lime, brown sugar and cinnamon.
